title: Music
tagline: Songs, playlists and charts are on their way
myListsEmptyTitle: No lists of your own yet
myListsEmptyDescription: Collected songs and lists you create appear here; songlists and charts need a music source first.
libraryEmptyTitle: The song library is on its way
libraryEmptyDescription: Once a music source lands, songs will page in here as a masonry grid of cards.
playlistsEmptyDescription: Playlists you curate and follow will live here.
chartsEmptyDescription: Popular-song charts from the music sources will live here.
defaultSourceDesc: The custom source a song is asked from first; Automatic takes the first enabled one.
qualityDesc: The rendition asked of a source; a source that lacks it answers with the best it has.
skipOnErrorDesc: Moves to the next source when one cannot answer, instead of stopping.
autoplayDesc: Continues the last queue when the music module opens.
addToTopDesc: Off keeps them at the end of a list.
showSourceDesc: Marks which source a song came from beside its row.
playbackResetDesc: Automatic source, 320K, skip failures, new songs at the end.
sourcesHint: lx-music custom sources are JavaScript scripts. Importing reads the header comment and keeps the script verbatim; this build does not execute scripts yet — that needs an embedded JS engine.
sourcesImportTextDesc: Paste the full text of an lx-music custom-source script.
sourcesImportUrlDesc: Downloads the .js at an address and imports it.
importMissing: Paste a script or fill in a link first.
importNotASource: This is not an lx-music source: the header comment has no @name, or the lx.on('request', …) contract is missing.
sourcesEmptyDesc: Import an lx-music custom-source script and it appears here.
sourceDeleteDesc: Its script is deleted too; importing it again restores it.
